topics.title: Solar PV String Inverter Sizing & MPPT Tracking
topics.objective: Calculate DC-to-AC oversizing ratios and maximum power point tracking (MPPT) voltage window matches.
topics.exercise: Size a 500kW rooftop PV string configuration matching ambient temperature extremes and inverter MPPT limits.

topics.title: Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Capacity & C-Rate Sizing
topics.objective: Size lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery energy capacity to handle 4-hour peak demand shaving and islanded backup.
topics.exercise: Determine BESS container dimensions and inverter bidirectional power ratings for a 1MWh commercial storage plant.

topics.title: Microgrid Controller (MGEMS) & Islanding Synchronization
topics.objective: Implement IEEE 1547 and IEEE 2030.7 compliant automated islanding and black-start transfer logic.
topics.exercise: Draft an automated microgrid islanding control state machine transitioning from grid-following to grid-forming mode.

topics.title: Active Power Quality & THD Harmonics Mitigation
topics.objective: Mitigate total harmonic distortion (THD) and maintain power factor between 0.95 leading/lagging using active front ends.
topics.exercise: Design an LC/LCL passive filter topology ensuring inverter THD remains below 3% under nonlinear load conditions.

topics.title: Time-of-Use (TOU) Tariff Arbitrage & Peak Demand Shaving
topics.objective: Formulate dynamic dispatch algorithms charging BESS during solar super-peak and discharging during peak evening tariff tiers.
topics.exercise: Write an optimization script scheduling battery dispatch against seasonal day-ahead electricity prices.
